keys.description: Animate the live-agent widget while a child waits on the lead; false shows a steady highlight instead.
Consecutive goal-loop reminders with no tool call before the loop force-stops.
Milliseconds the goal loop waits after the lead settles before it re-evaluates and sends the next reminder; also the wait before an unstarted wake is retried.

Context-usage percent at which the lead is advised to compact at its next safe boundary, and the reference shown in goal reminders. Interim context readings are steered one and two thirds of the way from here to compaction_hard_percent; at or above compaction_hard_percent, neither the advisory nor the readings fire.
Context-usage percent at which the lead is steered into compaction preparation at the next tool-call boundary.
Context-window size in tokens used for the context-usage percent; 0 uses the model's own window.
UTF-8 byte budget for the dialog section of the lead compaction summary: user messages, the lead's replies, and one line per tool call, newest first.
Days since a spawned child's last activity before its stored home is pruned at lead startup; 0 disables age pruning.
